semiconductor_relevance: High — Semilab specializes in metrology equipment crucial for the characterization and monitoring of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Semilab Taiwan Co. Ltd. designs, produces, and sells advanced metrology equipment for semiconductor and photovoltaic materials. Their solutions include non-contact and non-destructive measurement techniques that cater to both R&D and production environments.
capabilities: In-line measurements for solar cell production

regional_presence.Taiwan: Semilab has a significant presence in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor and photovoltaic sectors.
